warnings.text: 2 of 3 ad groups have one responsive search ad: "Sewer Line Replacement", "Sewer Camera Inspection". Google's tip is at least 2 in each ad group. One is enough to launch. Add a second when there is a different message to test.

warnings.where: Campaign "Sewer Line | Search" > Ad group "Sewer Line Repair" > Keyword "sewer line repair"

warnings.label: Official

checklist.label: Practitioner rule

checklist.item: Billing is set up and the payment method works.
checklist.verify: In Google Ads: Billing, Summary. Check there is no payment alert on the account.
checklist.label: Practitioner rule

checklist.item: Every final URL loads on mobile and on desktop, and matches its ad group.
checklist.verify: Open each final URL on the Ads sheet of the workbook on a phone and on a computer. Check the page offers what the ad offers.
checklist.label: Practitioner rule

checklist.item: The budget holder approved the daily budget and what it can add up to in a month.
checklist.verify: Show the budget holder the daily budget and the monthly spending limit on the Campaigns sheet, and get a yes in writing.
checklist.label: Practitioner rule

checklist.item: The business confirmed the locations.
checklist.verify: Read the locations on the Campaigns sheet to the business and confirm they are the places it serves.
checklist.label: Practitioner rule

checklist.item: The business approved the ad text.
checklist.verify: Send the Ad text sheet to the business. Every claim, price and offer in it must be true.
checklist.label: Practitioner rule

checklist.item: Every warning from the plan check is decided with the person (2 warnings)
checklist.verify: Read the Warnings sheet of the workbook. Write the decision beside each one.
checklist.label: Practitioner rule

checklist.stage: Import and review in Google Ads Editor
checklist.item: Import build-for-google-ads-editor.csv
checklist.verify: In Google Ads Editor: Account, Import, From file. Check the column headers Editor shows, then import.
checklist.label: Official

checklist.stage: Import and review in Google Ads Editor
checklist.item: Read every error and warning Editor lists
checklist.verify: Fix a problem in plan.json, run the check and the write step again, and import the new file. The workbook then still matches what is posted.
checklist.label: Official

checklist.stage: Import and review in Google Ads Editor
checklist.item: Count the proposed changes: 1 campaign, 2 locations, 3 ad groups, 14 keywords, 4 negative keywords and 4 responsive search ads
checklist.verify: Review imported changes. Imported rows arrive as proposed changes and nothing reaches the account until it is posted.
checklist.label: Official

checklist.stage: Import and review in Google Ads Editor
checklist.item: Every campaign, ad group, keyword and ad shows Paused
checklist.verify: Sort each view in Editor by status. Nothing in the file is set to serve.
checklist.label: Practitioner rule

checklist.stage: Import and review in Google Ads Editor
checklist.item: Every location is resolved
checklist.verify: A location typed by name must be resolved before posting. An unresolved location shows a yellow warning.
checklist.label: Official

checklist.stage: Import and review in Google Ads Editor
checklist.item: AI Max is off for Sewer Line | Search, as the plan chose
checklist.verify: Google turns AI Max on for every new Search campaign unless the file says off. This file says off. Check it reads Disabled in Editor.
checklist.label: Official

checklist.stage: Import and review in Google Ads Editor
checklist.item: The EU political ads declaration is right
checklist.verify: The file declares that each campaign doesn't have EU political ads, because Google Ads will not post a campaign without the declaration. If a campaign carries political content as Google defines it for the EU, change the declaration in Editor before posting.
checklist.label: Official

checklist.stage: Import and review in Google Ads Editor
checklist.item: Campaign "Sewer Line | Search": networks read Google Search, bid strategy reads Maximize conversions
checklist.verify: Open the campaign settings in Editor and compare them with the Campaigns sheet.
checklist.label: Practitioner rule

checklist.stage: Import and review in Google Ads Editor
checklist.item: Add the negative keyword list "Northside | Never relevant" (5 keywords) and apply it to every new campaign
checklist.verify: Paste negative-keyword-list.txt into a negative keyword list in Google Ads, then apply the list to each campaign of this build. Quotation marks mean phrase match and square brackets mean exact match.
checklist.label: Practitioner rule

checklist.stage: Import and review in Google Ads Editor
checklist.item: Keep the proposed changes and post
checklist.verify: Keep proposed changes, then post. Afterwards check in Google Ads that every campaign of this build still reads Paused.
checklist.label: Official

checklist.item: Every Stop launch item reads Said yes
checklist.verify: Read the first section of this checklist. One open item means no launch.
checklist.label: Practitioner rule

checklist.item: Open every final URL on a phone and on a computer
checklist.verify: Use the Ads sheet. Each page must load and offer what its ad offers.
checklist.label: Practitioner rule

checklist.item: No ad or keyword is disapproved in Google's policy review
checklist.verify: In Google Ads, read the status of each ad and keyword after posting.
checklist.label: Practitioner rule

checklist.item: Enable ads, keywords and ad groups, then enable the campaign last
checklist.verify: Enable in that order, so nothing serves half built.
checklist.label: Practitioner rule

checklist.item: Write down the hypothesis, the success metric and the early warning sign
checklist.verify: Hypothesis: Searches for sewer line repair, replacement and inspection in Denver and Aurora book jobs at a cost the business can carry, kept apart from drain cleaning. Success metric: Booked sewer appointments and cost per booking over the first 30 days. Early warning: Spend with no bookings after 14 days, or search terms about septic tanks or drain cleaning.
checklist.label: Practitioner rule

checklist.item: Serving: every campaign is eligible to serve
checklist.verify: Check campaign status in Google Ads on day 1 and day 2.
checklist.label: Practitioner rule

checklist.item: Pacing: one day can spend up to 240.00 and one month is charged at most 3,648.00 for this build
checklist.verify: That is the total daily budget of 120.00 times 2 and times 30.4. Compare cost each day with these limits.
checklist.label: Official

checklist.item: Tracking: the conversions this build is judged on are recorded
checklist.verify: The brief says: Booked appointment (online booking form). In Google Ads: Goals, Conversions, All conversions. Then check the campaign's Conversions column.
checklist.label: Practitioner rule

checklist.item: Search terms: read the search terms report and exclude what is plainly wrong
checklist.verify: If AI Max is on, Google says to wait at least 2 weeks after enabling before changes such as adding negatives.
checklist.label: Practitioner rule

checklist.item: Make one strategic change at a time
checklist.verify: Do not stack changes while the first signals form. Check conversion delay and low volume before calling a failure.
checklist.label: Practitioner rule
